title: SQL injection
description: Building SQL statements by formatting or concatenating user input lets an attacker change the query, read or modify data. Applies to f-strings, % formatting, .format and + concatenation passed to execute.
fix: Use parameterised queries: cur.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name=?", (u,)).

title: Hard-coded credentials
description: Passwords, API keys or tokens written in source code leak through version control and are hard to rotate.
fix: Read secrets from environment variables or a secrets manager: os.environ["API_KEY"].

title: Dynamic code evaluation (eval/exec)
description: eval and exec run strings as code, so attacker-controlled input becomes arbitrary code execution.
fix: Use ast.literal_eval for literals, or map allowed operations explicitly.

title: OS command injection
description: Passing user input to a shell via os.system or subprocess with shell=True lets an attacker append commands using characters such as ; and &&.
fix: Use subprocess.run(["ping", host], shell=False) and validate the input.

owasp: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures
title: Unsafe deserialisation (pickle)
description: Unpickling untrusted bytes can execute arbitrary code during loading.
fix: Use json for data exchange, or sign and verify data before loading.

owasp: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures
title: Unsafe YAML loading
description: yaml.load without a safe loader can construct arbitrary Python objects from untrusted YAML.

title: Weak hash algorithm (MD5/SHA-1)
description: MD5 and SHA-1 are broken for security use such as password storage or integrity checks.
fix: Use hashlib.sha256 for integrity, and bcrypt or argon2 for passwords.

title: Disabled TLS certificate verification
description: verify=False accepts any certificate, enabling man-in-the-middle attacks.
fix: Keep verify=True, or pass the path of a trusted CA bundle.

title: Debug mode enabled in production
description: Running a web app with debug=True exposes an interactive debugger and stack traces that can lead to remote code execution.
fix: Disable debug in production, e.g. app.run(debug=False) or read it from configuration.
